purpose: Teach: どり/いふ/叶え/生きよ/暮らせる/堪え/年表/きたり

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の段どり、社史で振り返ろう。
lines.en: Let's trace the company's founding story through our corporate history.
lines.style: Measured, decisive. Opens with quiet authority. Deliberate pace. No performance—a leader stating direction with the confidence of someone who has already decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い社内資料、いふ、と書く文書、まだ残っています。
lines.en: Yes. We still have the old internal documents from back then.
lines.style: Alert, respectful. Slight lean-forward—showing he's been thinking about this. Steady delivery, no hesitation. The competent subordinate confirming he's prepared.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の夢を叶えるために、社員一同、努める。
lines.en: Our staff exists to fulfill the founder's vision. We work together toward that.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath formality. Opens broader—this is principle, not just instruction. Steady eye level. A man stating what matters to him without softening it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員が、長く生きようと支え合う風土、続いています。
lines.en: Yes. The culture of supporting each other through difficulty has never wavered.
lines.style: Affirming, engaged. Slight nod in the voice. He's found the thread. Warm—not flattering, but genuinely moved by what he's saying. Carries the words like they matter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員が安心して暮らせる待遇、企業の責任だ。
lines.en: It's our responsibility to ensure our people can live securely. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firmer now. No room for debate. Straight delivery on the core principle. The conviction of someone who has lived this long enough to know what counts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。困難に堪える企業文化、強みです。
lines.en: Yes. That resilience through hardship—it's our real strength.
lines.style: Recognition in his tone. Quiet emphasis on 'resilience.' He's connecting the dots. Not rehearsed—genuine understanding lighting up the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業以来の年表、新人研修で、共有しろ。
lines.en: Share this founding timeline in our new employee training. Make it part of who we are.
lines.style: A directive, but not cold. Slightly slower on 'make it part'—leaning into the weight of what he's asking. Trusts Kenji to carry this forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。昔のしきたり、現代風にアレンジ、進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll bring the old traditions forward in a way that speaks to today.
lines.style: Closing confirmation with warmth. Slightly faster—momentum carrying him. He's got it. Breathes at the end like he's already imagining how to do this.
